PRISM

A gradient viewer and creator

JavaScriptCSSPWA MIT
Open app GitHub Releases

Prism is a small viewer and creator for CSS gradients.

 * Edit a gradient and see it as the page background right away.
 * Five presets to start from: Sunset, Ocean, Gold, Sky, and Purple.
 * Add or remove color stops, with a minimum of two.
 * Paste a CSS gradient string, or copy the one you built.
 * Text switches between black and white based on the gradient brightness.
 * Installs as a PWA.

LRCGETTER

Lyrics lookup, built for HTMLPlayer

VueViteCloudflare Workers MIT
Open app GitHub Releases

LRCGetter is a browser port of LRCGET for working with lyrics from LRCLib.

 * Pick a local music folder and browse your tracks.
 * Fetch synced or plain lyrics for a track from LRCLib.
 * Edit lyrics, including per-word timing.
 * Publish lyrics back to LRCLib.
 * Export lyrics as text or LRC, or embed them into the audio file.

It started as an integration test for HTMLPlayer.

HTMLVISUALIZER

Turn raw HTML into an interactive graph

HTMLJavaScriptD3.js GPL-3.0
Open beta Open app GitHub Releases

HTMLVisualizer turns an HTML document into an interactive graph so you can see
how its parts connect.


#FEATURES

 * Upload an HTML file to build a structure map.
 * Interactive graph with zoom, pan, and draggable nodes.
 * Links inline styles, stylesheet rules, and script-driven style changes to the
   elements they affect.
 * Pulls out functions, variables, and function calls from scripts.
 * Click a node to read its code in a side view. Every other connection dims so
   the selected node stands out.
 * Details panel for the selected node.
 * Works offline and installs as a PWA.

The repo and README still use the older name HTMLNodeMapper in places.

HTMLTRACK

Package tracking with live status and maps

ReactTypeScriptViteCloudflare Workers MIT
Open beta Open app GitHub Releases

HTMLTrack tracks parcels in one place and shows live status, delivery windows,
and a map of each destination.


#FEATURES

 * Parcels are stored in IndexedDB with a localStorage fallback, so they survive
   a refresh.
 * Delivery map built on MapLibre GL with Esri basemaps. No API key required,
   and markers follow the app theme.
 * Estimated delivery window with a relative countdown.
 * Full scan history per parcel, not just the latest status.
 * Carrier auto-detect for UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL, and Amazon.
 * Active parcels refresh every five minutes in one batched request.
 * Installs as a PWA.

The 17Track API key stays server-side in a small Cloudflare Worker.

 * Formatting with Prettier.

 * Dark and light mode, tabs, persistent state, and keyboard shortcuts.

There is no install and no server. The editor is a static page.

HTMLPLAYER

Flagship

Local-first audio player for web and desktop

ReactTypeScriptViteZustandTauri MIT
Open beta Open app GitHub Releases


HTMLPlayer is a local-first audio player for the browser and, through Tauri, for
Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Version 1 was a single HTML file. Version 2 is a rewrite in React, TypeScript,
Vite, and Zustand. The library lives in OPFS, so playback does not need a
server.


#FEATURES

 * Import with drag and drop, the file picker, a directory picker, the OS share
   sheet, or Web Share Target.
 * Playlists and folders, with drag-and-drop reordering and bulk select.
 * Metadata details: codec, bitrate, sample rate, channels, bit depth,
   container, profile, and gapless offsets.
 * Lyrics drawer that prefers embedded lyrics and falls back to lyrics.ovh.
 * Crossfade, optional gapless playback, smart shuffle, and preloading of the
   next track.
 * 60+ visualizers and a Document Picture-in-Picture mini player.
 * Themes, icon sets, wallpapers, editable keyboard shortcuts, and light, dark,
   or auto mode.
 * English and French translations.


#BUILD

 * Web: run npm install then npm run dev:web or npm run build:web inside Build/.
 * Desktop: npm run build:desktop with Tauri. Rust stable is required.
 * Node.js 18+ and npm 9+.

Development happens on the v2.0.0 branch. The main branch is behind.

HTMLCHAT

Experiment

A retro browser chat client

JavaScriptCloudflare Workers MIT
Open beta Open app GitHub Releases

HTMLChat is a browser chat client with a small edge backend instead of a
traditional server.

 * Rooms for general, random, offtopic, and computers chat.
 * Nicknames with color coding.
 * File uploads with previews, replies, and message search.
 * Moderator tools for delete and ban.
 * Settings for desktop notifications and sounds.
 * Export chat logs as JSON.

It is an experiment, so expect some rough edges. Messages are polled for now.
WebSockets are on the roadmap.

ReactTypeScriptViteCloudflare Workers MIT
Open beta Open app GitHub Releases

HTMLTrack tracks parcels in one place and shows live status, delivery windows,
and a map of each destination.


#FEATURES

 * Parcels are stored in IndexedDB with a localStorage fallback, so they survive
   a refresh.
 * Delivery map built on MapLibre GL with Esri basemaps. No API key required,
   and markers follow the app theme.
 * Estimated delivery window with a relative countdown.
 * Full scan history per parcel, not just the latest status.
 * Carrier auto-detect for UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL, and Amazon.
 * Active parcels refresh every five minutes in one batched request.
 * Installs as a PWA.

The 17Track API key stays server-side in a small Cloudflare Worker.

HTMLPLAYER

Flagship

Local-first audio player for web and desktop

ReactTypeScriptViteZustandTauri MIT
Open beta Open app GitHub Releases


HTMLPlayer is a local-first audio player for the browser and, through Tauri, for
Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Version 1 was a single HTML file. Version 2 is a rewrite in React, TypeScript,
Vite, and Zustand. The library lives in OPFS, so playback does not need a
server.


#FEATURES

 * Import with drag and drop, the file picker, a directory picker, the OS share
   sheet, or Web Share Target.
 * Playlists and folders, with drag-and-drop reordering and bulk select.
 * Metadata details: codec, bitrate, sample rate, channels, bit depth,
   container, profile, and gapless offsets.
 * Lyrics drawer that prefers embedded lyrics and falls back to lyrics.ovh.
 * Crossfade, optional gapless playback, smart shuffle, and preloading of the
   next track.
 * 60+ visualizers and a Document Picture-in-Picture mini player.
 * Themes, icon sets, wallpapers, editable keyboard shortcuts, and light, dark,
   or auto mode.
 * English and French translations.


#BUILD

 * Web: run npm install then npm run dev:web or npm run build:web inside Build/.
 * Desktop: npm run build:desktop with Tauri. Rust stable is required.
 * Node.js 18+ and npm 9+.

Development happens on the v2.0.0 branch. The main branch is behind.
